name: Sewer Call
summary: Sewer Call is an atmospheric indie horror game that plunges players into the dark, claustrophobic depths of an underground sewer system. Tasked with answering a mysterious call or investigating a sudden anomaly beneath the city, you must navigate a maze of damp tunnels. As you manage your limited resources and solve environmental puzzles to find a way out, you quickly realize you are not alone. Something dangerous lurks in the shadows, and every step could be your last.
